title: 第9章 道侣的回赠第10章 来拍卖场卖东西
content_zh:
来到了阁楼的一楼后，姜酥柔在一个蒲团上坐下，面前是一个茶几。
她伸掌指向茶几对面的蒲团，说道，
“师弟请坐。”
韩风坐到了对面，姜酥柔拿起茶壶，倒了一杯茶水，递给韩风。
“谢师姐。”
韩风保持着礼貌，而后，拿出了自己的寒冰匕首，说道，
“师姐，师弟昨晚得友人相赠一把匕首，不知道好坏，想请师姐帮忙品鉴一下。”
韩风这样做，是想要看看，他的寒冰匕首，到了别人手里后，还能不能用了。
毕竟，那个姻缘赐福说过，赐福给的任何东西，都无法转赠给任何人。
韩风想要看看，这个无法转赠，是给不了别人啊，还是给了别人后，别人不能用。
如果是前者，那么他用三十年三针花换三百年三针花卖钱的计划，就泡汤了。
毕竟一个无法给别人的东西，也卖不了钱啊。
如果是后者，那么他便可以想办法伪装操作一下，来卖出去灵石。
姜酥柔见状，拿过那把匕首，而后尝试着输入灵气，片刻后，匕首没有丝毫变化。
她摇头道，
“不过是一把凡铁罢了，连灵气都无法容纳，没有半点用处，还不如你昨日那把锈迹斑斑的下品灵器呢。
不过礼轻情意重，毕竟是你友人送的，还是留着吧。”
说完话，她便将匕首还给了韩风。
韩风接过匕首，收了起来。
也就是说，他的东西，别人拿在手里，也没办法用。

这样一来，以后就算是别人抢了他的东西，也休想拿去用。
虽说灵器灵宝是谁都能用，到了法宝级后，就需要认主后才能用，不认主没办法用，但还是有厉害之人能够强行抹去法宝的原主人印记，然后认主使用的。
他有了这一招，以后得到赐福的东西，谁都别想拿去用了。
这个赐福，还真是好东西啊。
其实应该拿去给王冕试一下，才是最好最安全的，但他来到此地后才想到了这一点，只能找姜酥柔试一下了。
既然东西可以送出去，那他就可以兑换三百年药龄的三针花了。
韩风拿出储物袋，而后轻轻一拍，手里多出来一根房屋一样高的三针花。
“嗯？什么味道，好香好香。”
在韩风脖子里趴着睡觉的小狐狸，闻到三针花的香味后，立刻便瞪大了眼睛，双眼放光的看向那朵三针花。
姜酥柔看了一眼小狐狸，刚刚她还以为那是韩风脖子里围着一条围脖呢，没想到是一只灵兽。
“好可爱的灵兽啊，我可以抱抱它吗？”
姜酥柔再高冷，也是个十几岁的女孩子，对于小狐狸这种可爱到极点的生物，没什么抵抗力的。
韩风尴尬的笑了笑，将三针花横着放到了桌子上，说道，
“师姐，看看这朵三针花如何？”
闻言，姜酥柔看了看后，淡然说道，
“这三针花，是炼制复灵丹的主要材料吧？看大小，应该有几十年药龄，能换几百灵石吧。”
几百灵石，对于姜酥柔而言，根本不算什么，她没多稀罕。
content_en:
After arriving on the first floor of the attic, Jiang Surou sat down on a futon with a coffee table in front of her.
She pointed to the futon opposite the coffee table and said,
"Junior brother, please sit down."
Han Feng sat opposite, Jiang Surou picked up the teapot, poured a cup of tea and handed it to Han Feng.
"Thank you, senior sister."
Han Feng remained polite, then took out his ice dagger and said,
"Senior Sister, Junior Brother received a dagger as a gift from a friend last night. I don't know if it is good or bad. I would like to ask Senior Sister to help me taste it."
Han Feng did this because he wanted to see if his ice dagger could still be used after it was in the hands of others.
After all, that marriage blessing said that anything given by the blessing cannot be transferred to anyone.
Han Feng wanted to see if this could not be transferred, so it could not be given to others, or if it was given to others, others could not use it.
If it's the former, then his plan to exchange thirty-year-old three-pin flowers for three-hundred-year-old three-hundred-year needle flowers has come to nothing.
After all, something that cannot be given to others cannot be sold for money.
If it was the latter, then he could find a way to pretend to operate it and sell the spirit stones.
Jiang Surou saw this, took the dagger, and then tried to input spiritual energy. After a while, the dagger did not change at all.
She shook her head and said,
"It's just a handful of mortal iron. It can't even contain spiritual energy. It's useless at all. It's worse than the rusty low-grade spiritual weapon you had yesterday.
However, the gift is light but the affection is heavy. After all, it was given by your friend, so you might as well keep it. "
After speaking, she returned the dagger to Han Feng.
Han Feng took the dagger and put it away.
In other words, others cannot use his things if they are in their hands.
In this way, even if someone robs his things in the future, they will never be able to use them.
Although spiritual weapons and spiritual treasures can be used by anyone, once they reach the magic weapon level, they need to recognize their owner before they can use them. If you don't recognize the owner, you can't use them. However, there are still powerful people who can forcibly erase the mark of the original owner of the magic weapon and then recognize its owner and use it.
With this trick, no one can use the things he is blessed with in the future.
This blessing is really a good thing.
In fact, it would be best and safest to give it to Wang Mian to try, but he only thought of this after arriving here, so he could only try it with Jiang Surou.
Since the things can be given away, he can exchange them for three hundred-year-old medicine.
Han Feng took out his storage bag, then patted it gently, and a three-needle flower as tall as a house appeared in his hand.
"Huh? What does it smell like? It smells so good."
The little fox sleeping on Han Feng's neck immediately opened his eyes wide when he smelled the fragrance of the three-needle flower, and looked at the three-needle flower with bright eyes.
Jiang Surou glanced at the little fox. Just now she thought it was Han Feng wearing a scarf around his neck, but she didn't expect it to be a spiritual beast.
"What a cute spiritual beast. Can I hug it?"
No matter how aloof Jiang Surou is, she is still a teenage girl. She has no resistance to such an extremely cute creature like a little fox.
Han Feng smiled awkwardly, placed the three-pin flower horizontally on the table, and said,
"Senior sister, how about taking a look at this three-needle flower?"
Hearing this, Jiang Surou looked at it and said calmly,
"These three-needle flowers are the main material for refining the spirit-restoring pill, right? Judging from the size, it should be several decades old and can be exchanged for hundreds of spirit stones."
Several hundred spirit stones were nothing to Jiang Surou, and she didn't care much about them.
